# DeviationIndicator

<!-- Generated by js/scripts/widget-pages.mjs from the trait contract: edit the schema
     or the script, then run it again. -->

Centre-zero bar of the deviation between a value and its setpoint (IND-100).

![DeviationIndicator, light theme](../img/widgets/deviation-indicator-light.png#only-light){ width="228" }
![DeviationIndicator, dark theme](../img/widgets/deviation-indicator-dark.png#only-dark){ width="228" }

**Compact indicators** · [Widget catalog](../widgets.md) · [API reference](../api.md#anywidget_instruments.DeviationIndicator) ·
schema [`deviation.schema.json`](../trait-contract.md)

## Example

The traits of the picture above:

```python
ai.DeviationIndicator(
    value=52.3,
    label="Deviation",
    setpoint=50,
    tolerance=1.5,
    span=5,
    unit="°C",
    format="%.1f",
)
```

## Traits

| Trait | Type | Default | Set by | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `format` | string | `"%.2f"` | host | printf-like spec of the deviation (NUM-004). |
| `mode` | `"control"`, `"indicator"` | `"indicator"` | host | "control": the user sets the value; "indicator": display only. |
| `setpoint` | number | `0` | host | Setpoint; the bar shows value - setpoint. |
| `size` | array | `[220,44]` | host | [width, height] in CSS pixels. |
| `span` | number | `10` | host | Half-range of the bar (must be > 0). |
| `tolerance` | number | `1` | host | Half-width of the tolerance band; outside it the bar takes the alarm color and reads HIGH or LOW. |
| `unit` | string | `""` | host | Unit shown with the deviation. |
| `value` | number | `"nan"` | host | Measured value. |
